goal: Prevent makeseeds from crashing with an IndexError on truncated DNS seeder records
Allow seed generation to skip malformed 11-field lines instead of aborting the run
agreement: Strong support with all objections resolved (l0rinc, maflcko)
Concerns about adding unrun test code for a niche utility resolved by dropping the tests (achow101, maflcko)
Notes the bug is fine to fix but an edge case unlikely to matter in practice (maflcko)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because prevents an unhandled crash in offline seed generation on malformed input
Encountering truncated seeder records with exactly 11 fields is an edge case with minimal disruption
